# JSON for Modern C++

Vendored `json.hpp` from nlohmann/json **v3.12.0**, MIT license (LICENSE.MIT).
Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
Published json.hpp SHA-256:
`aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`.

The fork had no JSON reader. This header-only dependency gives the game and
headless content tools one portable parser without a Python runtime requirement.
Project wrappers impose document/depth/node/string limits and reject duplicate
keys before accepting definitions. Do not edit or format the upstream header.
